claims.text: For each x in −2…2, you have y=2x−1 and y=2x+1. Restricting x to −1,0,1 changes Pearson correlation to about what?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-restricted-range/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Ten points: each x in [-2,-1,0,1,2] appears twice, with y=2x-1 and y=2x+1. Full r=sqrt(8/9)≈.94281. Restrict x to [-1,0,1]: r=sqrt(8/11)≈.85280. Restrict to x=0: r undefined because x has zero variance. Fixed y rule; only the admitted range changes.
